name: Scaly-breasted Munia
desc: Scaly-breasted Munia (Lonchura punctulata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The scaly-breasted munia or spotted munia, known in the pet trade as nutmeg mannikin or spice finch, is a sparrow-sized estrildid finch native to tropical Asia.
